output.summary: A genus of tropical plants ranging from short shrubs to tall upright forms, native to tropical Africa, southern and eastern Asia, Australia and various oceanic islands. Male and female flowers occur on separate plants. Its fleshy, juicy fruits are edible and change from white through red to black as they ripen.
output.edibilityNote: Fleshy, juicy fruits are edible and taste sour to bittersweet; some people find Antidesma bunius berries bitter.
